facts: The former stock exchange was built to the designs of Francesco Boffo and Giorgio Torricelli. The civic façade has white columns, niche statues of Mercury and Ceres, and a historic clock with allegorical figures.

The Exchange was substantially completed in 1834. The 1871–1873 alteration enclosed the former forecourt behind the column line and gave the main façade more sculptural detail in its wings and center.
The old exchange now serves as City Hall and defines one end of the Primorsky Boulevard ensemble on Dumska Square.
